title: Pokemon TCG 2017 Burning Shadows Card - Regular Rare 43/147 Electivire
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokémon TCG 2017 Burning Shadows Card is an amazing addition to your collection. It features the character Electivire, a Stage 1 Pokémon with the Attribute of Lightning. The card is made of high-quality card stock and has a standard size. 

This card is a Rare find with a card number of 43/147. It is part of the Burning Shadows set and was manufactured by Nintendo in 2017. The card is in English language and has a regular finish. It is perfect for collectors and players of the Pokémon TCG game.
